lines.t:
An automatic effect that works against a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>.
Mostly applied by the {{opponent}}'s <c:ffff00>Striking<c> and
<c:ffff00>Shooting<c> <c:ffff00>actions<c>. A {{medabot}} can hold up to 6 types;
beyond that the oldest vanish. They last a set time
or number of <c:ffff00>acts<c>; some end under specific
conditions.
{{stacking|cap}} the same {{negative_status}} resets its
duration or count.
